caption:
Citrus only: a citrus press. Mostly hard fruit and roots: centrifugal. Leafy greens, herbs or wheatgrass: masticating or twin-gear. Pulp should come out dry and crumbly; wet pulp means juice was thrown away. Claude chooses the Nama J2, a slow juicer with a self-feeding hopper; GPT chooses the Breville Juice Fountain Plus JE98XL. https://1billionmodels.com/home-and-kitchen/kitchen-and-dining/kitchen-small-appliances/juicers?src=youtube&utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer

Two AI models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT 6.1 Sol) chose with no web access; nobody tested these products. Synthetic voice.
